description: This file defines atomic operations and atomic types for thread-safe programming, including classes for atomic integers, floats, booleans, and pointers, with inline functions for atomic compare-and-swap, load, store, and increment operations.

classes.name: atomic_base
classes.description: Template class providing thread-safe atomic operations for trivially copyable types, using mutex for synchronization.

classes.name: atomic_number
classes.description: Subclass of atomic_base adding fetch_add and fetch_sub methods for numeric types.

classes.name: atomic_integral
classes.description: Subclass of atomic_number adding increment and decrement methods for integer types.

classes.name: atomic_pointer
classes.description: Template class for atomic pointer types.

classes.name: atomic_bool
classes.description: Atomic boolean type with lock-free operations.

methods.name: Release_CompareAndSwap
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-swap with release semantics.

methods.name: NoBarrier_Store
methods.description: Performs an atomic store without memory barriers.

methods.name: NoBarrier_Load
methods.description: Performs an atomic load without memory barriers.

methods.name: NoBarrier_CompareAndSwap
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-swap without memory barriers.

methods.name: NoBarrier_Exchange
methods.description: Performs an atomic exchange without memory barriers.

methods.name: NoBarrier_Increment
methods.description: Performs an atomic increment without memory barriers.

methods.name: Barrier_Increment
methods.description: Performs an atomic increment with memory barriers.

methods.name: Acquire_CompareAndSwap
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-swap with acquire semantics.

methods.name: Release_CompareAndSwap
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-swap with release semantics.
